extra_vocab.en: a meal where people take food from tables by themselves
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於飯店早餐、會議午餐與活動餐點的情境。注意發音是 /bəˈfeɪ/，字尾的 t 不發音。

example.en: Many hotels offer weekend buffets with seafood and desserts.
example.zh: 許多飯店在週末提供有海鮮和甜點的自助餐。

example.en: The breakfast buffet opens at six thirty every morning.
example.zh: 自助早餐每天早上六點半開始供應。

example.en: A buffet dinner is included in the tour price.
example.zh: 自助晚餐已包含在旅遊費用中。

example.en: Please line up at the buffet table in an orderly way.
example.zh: 請在自助餐檯前依序排隊。

examples.en: Guests can enjoy a large buffet in the hotel restaurant.
examples.zh: 客人可以在飯店餐廳享用豐盛的自助餐。

examples.en: A buffet will be served after the opening speech.
examples.zh: 開幕致詞後會供應自助餐。

examples.en: Lunch at the seminar will be a buffet, so choose any dish.
examples.zh: 研討會的午餐是自助餐，所以任何菜色都可以選。

similar.diff: banquet 是有固定座位、依序上菜的正式宴會；buffet 是自己去取餐的自助式。

example.en: Guests sat at round tables for the formal banquet.
example.zh: 賓客坐在圓桌前參加正式宴會。

example.en: The chef's best dish is grilled fish with lemon.
example.zh: 主廚最拿手的菜是檸檬烤魚。

example.en: The hotel serves breakfast from six to ten.
example.zh: 飯店從六點到十點供應早餐。

example.en: Please take a clean plate from the end of the table.
example.zh: 請從桌子的盡頭拿一個乾淨的盤子。

extra_vocab.en: a piece of furniture with shelves for books
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於辦公室擺設、家具採購與搬家的情境，用來放書、文件與手冊。

example.en: We ordered four tall bookcases for the new library room.
example.zh: 我們為新的閱覽室訂了四個高書櫃。

example.en: A wooden bookcase stands behind the reception desk.
example.zh: 櫃檯後方立著一個木製書櫃。

example.en: The study has a built-in bookcase along one wall.
example.zh: 書房有一面牆嵌著書櫃。

example.en: It took two hours to assemble a bookcase without help.
example.zh: 沒有人幫忙，組裝一個書櫃花了兩個小時。

examples.en: The manager keeps all the product manuals in the bookcase.
examples.zh: 經理把所有產品手冊都放在書櫃裡。

examples.en: This bookcase comes in three sizes and four colors.
examples.zh: 這款書櫃有三種尺寸和四種顏色。

examples.en: The movers carried the heavy bookcase up to the office.
examples.zh: 搬運工把沉重的書櫃搬上辦公室。

confusable.diff: bookcase 是放書的書櫃；briefcase 是上班用的公事包，兩字後半都是 -case。

example.en: He took the files from the bookcase and put them in his briefcase.
example.zh: 他從書櫃拿出檔案，放進他的公事包。

similar.diff: bookshelf 指放書的架子或其中一層；bookcase 通常指有側板的整座書櫃。

example.en: Please put the dictionary on the top bookshelf.
example.zh: 請把字典放在最上層的書架。

example.en: The files are on the second shelf from the top.
example.zh: 檔案放在由上往下數的第二層架子上。

example.en: The new office furniture will arrive on Monday.
example.zh: 新的辦公家具星期一會送到。

example.en: Please leave the documents on my desk.
example.zh: 請把文件放在我的桌上。

extra_vocab.zh: 一定會；開往…的；受約束的
extra_vocab.en: sure to happen, going to a place, or having to follow a rule
extra_vocab.note: 多益常以三種固定用法出現：be bound to + V（一定會）、bound for + 地點（開往）、be bound by + 規定（受…約束）。要依後面接的詞來判斷意思。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: be bound to 後面接原形動詞；bound for 後面接地點；be bound by 後面接合約、法律或規定。

example.en: With this advertising, sales are bound to improve.
example.zh: 有了這個廣告，銷售一定會成長。

example.en: A cargo ship bound for Singapore left the port today.
example.zh: 一艘開往新加坡的貨輪今天離開了港口。

example.en: Employees are bound by the company's privacy rules.
example.zh: 員工受公司隱私規定的約束。

examples.en: The new phone is bound to be popular with young buyers.
examples.zh: 這款新手機一定會受到年輕買家的歡迎。

examples.en: Passengers bound for Tokyo should go to Gate Five.
examples.zh: 前往東京的乘客請到五號登機門。

examples.en: We are legally bound by the agreement we signed last year.
examples.zh: 我們在法律上受去年簽的協議約束。

similar.diff: sure to 意思接近 be bound to，更口語；bound 帶有「幾乎不可避免」的語氣。

example.en: The offer is sure to attract new customers.
example.zh: 這項優惠一定能吸引新客戶。

example.en: The meeting is likely to end before noon.
example.zh: 會議很可能在中午前結束。

example.en: The seller has an obligation to repair the product.
example.zh: 賣方有義務修理這項產品。

example.en: Our final destination is the head office in Seoul.
example.zh: 我們的最終目的地是首爾的總公司。

senses.distinguish: 後面接 to + 原形動詞，如 be bound to rise。

example.en: Mistakes are bound to happen when the schedule is this tight.
example.zh: 時程這麼緊，難免會出錯。

senses.distinguish: 後面接 for + 地點，常用在交通工具或乘客。

example.en: The bus bound for the airport leaves every thirty minutes.
example.zh: 開往機場的巴士每三十分鐘一班。

senses.en: having to follow a rule or a promise
senses.distinguish: 後面接 by + 合約、法律，或 to + 原形動詞表示義務。

example.en: The seller is bound by law to return the deposit.
example.zh: 賣方依法有義務退還訂金。

extra_vocab.en: to make something wider or include more things
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於行銷、訓練與職涯情境，如 broaden the customer base（擴大客群）、broaden one's experience（增廣見聞）。多半指抽象的範圍變廣。

example.en: Each new project broadens her skills as a designer.
example.zh: 每個新專案都拓展了她身為設計師的技能。

example.en: The survey broadened our understanding of customer needs.
example.zh: 這份調查拓展了我們對客戶需求的了解。

example.en: Broadening our market will take time and a larger budget.
example.zh: 擴大我們的市場需要時間和更多預算。

example.en: Online ads can broaden the customer base quickly.
example.zh: 網路廣告可以快速擴大客群。

collocations.zh: 增廣見聞、累積更廣的經驗

example.en: Working abroad helped him broaden his experience in sales.
example.zh: 在國外工作幫助他拓展業務方面的經驗。

example.en: The store plans to broaden the range of organic products.
example.zh: 這家店計畫擴大有機產品的種類。

examples.en: We want to broaden our product line to attract more buyers.
examples.zh: 我們想擴大產品線，以吸引更多買家。

examples.en: The training course will broaden your knowledge of financial planning.
examples.zh: 這門訓練課程會拓展你對財務規劃的知識。

examples.en: The new partnership may broaden access to overseas markets.
examples.zh: 這項新合作可能擴大進入海外市場的管道。

confusable.diff: broaden 是「拓寬」；broadcast 是「廣播、播送」，兩字開頭都是 broad-。

example.en: The station will broadcast the CEO's speech live.
example.zh: 電台將現場播出執行長的演說。

similar.diff: expand 強調規模、數量變大；broaden 強調範圍或種類變廣。

example.en: The company plans to expand its business into Asia.
example.zh: 公司計畫把業務擴展到亞洲。

similar.diff: widen 多指道路、差距等實體寬度變寬；broaden 多指抽象範圍的擴大。

example.en: The city will widen the road to reduce traffic jams.
example.zh: 市政府將拓寬道路以減少塞車。

example.en: We decided to extend the sale for one more week.
example.zh: 我們決定把特賣再延長一週。

example.en: The new system will improve our delivery speed.
example.zh: 新系統會提升我們的出貨速度。

example.en: The café offers a wide variety of teas.
example.zh: 這間咖啡店提供種類繁多的茶。

derived.link: 基本形容詞「寬的」；broad + -en，「使變寬」，像 wide → widen、short → shorten

extra_vocab.en: to look at things or pages without a special plan
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於網站購物、商店與資料查閱的情境，指沒有明確目標地隨意瀏覽。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: browse 可以直接接受詞（browse the website），也可接 through；沒有特定目標才用 browse，找特定資料用 search for。

example.en: Each visitor browses the exhibit at his own speed.
example.zh: 每位參觀者都照自己的步調瀏覽展覽。

example.en: He browsed the job listings during his lunch break.
example.zh: 他在午休時間瀏覽了徵才資訊。

example.en: Browsing the website is free, but ordering needs an account.
example.zh: 瀏覽網站是免費的，但訂購需要帳號。

example.en: Please browse the catalog and choose three items.
example.zh: 請瀏覽型錄並選三項商品。

example.en: Take time to browse through the documents before you sign.
example.zh: 簽名前請花時間翻閱這些文件。

example.en: Many people browse online before they visit a store.
example.zh: 許多人在去實體店前會先上網瀏覽。

examples.en: Customers can browse our latest products on the website.
examples.zh: 顧客可以在網站上瀏覽我們的最新產品。

examples.en: Feel free to browse the store while you wait.
examples.zh: 等候時請隨意逛逛店裡。

examples.en: I will browse the report before the meeting starts.
examples.zh: 我會在會議開始前瀏覽一下這份報告。

similar.diff: look through 較強調「大略翻看」文件或資料；browse 也可用於逛店或逛網站。

example.en: Please look through the contract before you sign it.
example.zh: 簽約前請先翻看一下合約。

similar.diff: search for 有明確要找的東西；browse 則沒有特定目標。

example.en: I need to search for the invoice in my email.
example.zh: 我需要在電子郵件裡找那張發票。

example.en: You can find the schedule on our website.
example.zh: 您可以在我們的網站上找到時間表。

example.en: The new catalog will be mailed next week.
example.zh: 新型錄下週會寄出。

example.en: You can download the form from the company website.
example.zh: 您可以從公司網站下載這份表格。

derived.link: browse + -er，「做瀏覽這件事的工具」，像 teach → teacher

extra_vocab.en: a soft yellow food made from milk that you put on bread
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐廳、烘焙與食材採購的情境。也可當動詞，表示「塗奶油」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: butter 當「奶油」是不可數名詞，不加 s；要說一塊奶油用 a piece of butter 或 a stick of butter。

example.en: The chef butters each slice before he grills the sandwich.
example.zh: 主廚在烤三明治前會在每片麵包上塗奶油。

example.en: The cook buttered the pans so the cakes would not stick.
example.zh: 廚師在烤盤上塗了奶油，蛋糕才不會黏住。

example.en: Buttering the bread early makes it soft by lunchtime.
example.zh: 提早塗好奶油，麵包到午餐時間就會變軟。

example.en: The café offers toast with peanut butter and honey.
example.zh: 這間咖啡店供應塗花生醬和蜂蜜的吐司。

example.en: Melt the butter slowly before adding the flour.
example.zh: 加入麵粉前，先把奶油慢慢融化。

example.en: The recipe calls for a stick of butter and two eggs.
example.zh: 這份食譜需要一條奶油和兩顆蛋。

examples.en: The waiter brought bread and a small dish of butter.
examples.zh: 服務生送來麵包和一小碟奶油。

examples.en: The bakery uses real butter instead of oil in its cakes.
examples.zh: 這間烘焙坊的蛋糕使用真正的奶油而不是油。

examples.en: Please add butter and eggs to the weekly supply order.
examples.zh: 請把奶油和雞蛋加到每週的補給訂單裡。

confusable.diff: butter 是「奶油」；butler 是「管家」，兩字只差一個字母。

example.en: The hotel butler carried the luggage to the guest's room.
example.zh: 飯店管家把行李送到客人的房間。

similar.diff: margarine 是植物油做的人造奶油；butter 是用牛奶做的天然奶油。

example.en: The bakery uses margarine in its low-cost cookies.
example.zh: 這間烘焙坊在平價餅乾中使用人造奶油。

example.en: The sandwich comes with cheese and fresh tomatoes.
example.zh: 這份三明治附有起司和新鮮番茄。

example.en: The bread is baked fresh every morning.
example.zh: 麵包每天早上現烤。

example.en: Every ingredient in this cake is made locally.
example.zh: 這個蛋糕的每一項食材都是當地生產的。

example.en: We ran out of butter, so the baker went to the store.
example.zh: 我們的奶油用完了，所以麵包師傅去了商店。

example.en: Please butter the rolls before the guests sit down.
example.zh: 請在客人入座前把小餐包塗上奶油。

extra_vocab.en: a small card or sign that shows who you are
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於展覽、公司門禁與研討會報到的情境，指識別證或名牌，也可指徽章。

example.en: The company printed new badges for all conference speakers.
example.zh: 公司為所有研討會講者印製了新的識別證。

example.en: Please put on your name badge before the conference begins.
example.zh: 研討會開始前請別上您的名牌。

example.en: A security badge is needed to enter the server room.
example.zh: 進入機房需要門禁識別證。

example.en: All staff must wear a badge while working in the lab.
example.zh: 所有員工在實驗室工作時都必須佩戴識別證。

examples.en: Please show your badge at the entrance of the exhibition hall.
examples.zh: 請在展覽館入口出示您的識別證。

examples.en: New employees will receive a badge on their first day.
examples.zh: 新進員工第一天就會拿到識別證。

examples.en: Visitors must return the badge to the front desk before leaving.
examples.zh: 訪客離開前必須把識別證還給櫃檯。

confusable.diff: badge 是「識別證」；budget 是「預算」，兩字拼法與發音都有些相似。

example.en: The team needs more budget for the exhibition.
example.zh: 團隊需要更多預算來辦這場展覽。

similar.diff: ID card 強調「身分證件」；badge 多是掛在身上的識別證，常用於公司或活動。

example.en: You need an ID card to enter the building after six.
example.zh: 六點後進入大樓需要證件。

similar.diff: pass 是「通行證」，可短期使用；badge 通常是固定身分的識別證。

example.en: Each visitor gets a day pass at the front desk.
example.zh: 每位訪客會在櫃檯領到一張一日通行證。

example.en: Every visitor must sign in at the front desk.
example.zh: 每位訪客都必須在櫃檯簽到。

example.en: Security will check your bag at the entrance.
example.zh: 保全會在入口檢查您的包包。

example.en: Only managers have access to the storage room.
example.zh: 只有主管能進入儲藏室。

extra_vocab.en: a person who works in a bank, often in a high position
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於貸款、投資與財務研討會的情境，多指在銀行處理貸款或投資的專業人士，比一般櫃員的層級高。

example.en: Bankers around the world are watching the interest rate closely.
example.zh: 世界各地的銀行業者都在密切關注利率。

example.en: She worked as an investment banker in London for ten years.
example.zh: 她在倫敦當了十年的投資銀行家。

example.en: The senior banker approved the company's request for credit.
example.zh: 資深銀行家核准了公司的信貸申請。

example.en: A local banker gave advice to new store owners.
example.zh: 一位當地銀行業者給新店主一些建議。

examples.en: The banker explained the loan conditions to the small business owner.
examples.zh: 銀行業者向小型企業主說明貸款條件。

examples.en: Our banker called to say the transfer has been completed.
examples.zh: 我們的銀行專員來電說匯款已經完成。

examples.en: A well-known banker will open the financial forum on Monday.
examples.zh: 一位知名的銀行家將在星期一為財經論壇開場。

confusable.diff: banker 是銀行業者；baker 是麵包師傅，兩字只差一個字母 n。

example.en: The baker delivered the cake to the banker's office.
example.zh: 麵包師傅把蛋糕送到銀行家的辦公室。

similar.diff: bank teller 是櫃檯處理存提款的行員；banker 通常指處理貸款、投資的較高階人員。

example.en: The bank teller counted the cash and gave me a receipt.
example.zh: 銀行櫃員點好現金並給了我一張收據。

example.en: The bank approved a loan for the new factory.
example.zh: 銀行核准了新工廠的貸款。

example.en: Please transfer the money to my savings account.
example.zh: 請把錢轉到我的儲蓄帳戶。

example.en: The interest on this loan is only three percent.
example.zh: 這筆貸款的利息只有百分之三。

derived.link: 基本字「銀行」；bank + -er，在銀行工作的人，像 teach → teacher
bank + -ing，把「做銀行這件事」變成名詞，像 online banking
